notes: Deliberately one tiny input against a large context, so anything that goes wrong is attributable to context handling rather than to parsing the capture. Three failure modes are in scope and all are graded by the exact-match pass: restating items already present in the note, dropping the new item because the context crowded it out, and losing the parent when the known-parents list gets long. This is the first fixture where 'Vehicle Maintenance' is both a known parent and the obviously correct one, so parent_hint is asserted positively here rather than as an empty-string restraint check. Also the only fixture with a context block big enough for context_max_chars to bind at all: 1370 characters against every other fixture's 95. It does not bind at the current 2000 default - the cap experiment in slice 6 has to sweep below 1370 to produce a number, and this fixture is the only reason such a sweep measures anything.
